# Draft:Finexer Open Banking

----
Finexer is a British financial technology company providing open banking and payment solutions for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs). Operating as a Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) regulated entity, the company offers API-driven banking integration and payment services.
Products and Services
The company's platform enables real-time financial data access and bank-to-bank payments through open banking technology.
Key features include:
Transactions Data-Real-time bank transaction data
Balance check - Income, expense and balance data
Authenticate - Account details, sort code, IBAN and BIC
Instant Pay-by-Bank capabilities
White-label solutions
API-based deployment
Industry Applications
Finexer serves multiple sectors including property technology, legal services, enterprise resource planning, credit and lending, gaming, utilities, and financial services.
